assertion: With no participant facts, nothing is written, and with every fact, nothing outside the caption is written.
reason: JDF 416 Guide to Sealing Arrest Records (No Charges Filed) (R: July 1, 2025) lists this document among the forms the petitioner files and says how much of it to complete: "JDF 419 Notice (Just do §§ A-C)". The caption is the petitioner's and everything after it is the court's, so only caption facts bind and every other field is refused by role.
